themes_detail.label: Street Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from streets and sidewalks spiked to 10 complaints THIS WEEK, up 208% from the 3.2-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 3.4), suggesting a sudden new source of disruption in the district.
evidence: 10 Noise - Street/Sidewalk complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
z-score of 3.4, indicating statistically significant spike
208% increase from baseline in most recent week
reporting_angles: Interview residents in complaint hotspots to identify common source (construction, commercial activity, transit)
Cross-reference with DOB permits (741 filings in last 90 days, 284 new buildings) to see if recent construction is triggering noise

themes_detail.label: Park Noise Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Noise - Park complaints exploded to 4 complaints 2 weeks ago, a 3100% spike from the 0.1-complaint weekly baseline (z-score: 11.72), indicating a dramatic and sustained park use or event issue affecting quality of life.
evidence: 4 Noise - Park complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
z-score of 11.72, the highest statistical anomaly in dataset
3100% increase indicates near-zero baseline with sudden major event or activity
reporting_angles: Identify which parks in Tottenville/Great Kills saw complaints; check Parks Department event calendars for recent activities or programming changes
Interview Parks Department about whether parks are understaffed or under-monitored for noise violations

themes_detail.label: Park and Lot Maintenance Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Maintenance or Facility complaints jumped to 12 THIS WEEK, up 182% from the 4.2-complaint weekly average (z-score: 4.34), and Lot Condition complaints hit 3 last week, up 1100% from 0.2 average (z-score: 4.16), suggesting deterioration of public spaces.
evidence: 12 Maintenance or Facility complaints THIS WEEK vs. 4.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (182% spike, z-score: 4.34)
3 Lot Condition complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score: 4.16)
Combined signal suggests Parks or Sanitation service degradation across multiple asset types
reporting_angles: Request Parks Department work orders and closure reports for the past 2 weeks to identify which facilities are failing
Investigate whether staffing shortages or budget constraints in Parks or Sanitation are driving the uptick

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dog Enforcement Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed Dog complaints surged to 4 last week, up 700% from the 0.5-complaint weekly baseline (z-score: 4.95), pointing to either a breakdown in animal control enforcement or a specific incident triggering reports.
evidence: 4 Unleashed Dog complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Suggests either new pack behavior or reduced enforcement response
reporting_angles: Contact NYPD Animal Care and Control to ask if there's a known problem area or incident in Tottenville/Great Kills
Reach out to park-goers and dog owners to identify whether there's a specific location or owner triggering complaints

themes_detail.label: Air Quality Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Air Quality complaints hit 5 two weeks ago, up 233% from the 1.5-complaint weekly average (z-score: 4.04), potentially signaling industrial or traffic emissions affecting residents.
evidence: 5 Air Quality complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
South Shore Industrial Center project in pipeline (non-ULURP, filed stage) may be correlated or presaging future concern
reporting_angles: Check EPA AirNow data for Richmond County during the spike window to see if external air quality sensors corroborate complaints
Interview residents on nature of complaints (smell, dust, visible emissions) and geographic cluster to pinpoint source
